intro: に沿って means running alongside a line and not leaving it. The line can be physical (a river, a road, a coast) or abstract (a plan, a policy, a manual, a customer's wishes), and the action keeps close to it all the way. Directly before a noun it becomes に沿った.

skills.rule: Line or guideline + に沿って: along it physically, or in line with it, keeping close to it without departing.
skills.explain:
に沿って has two uses with one image. Literally, it follows a long physical feature: 川に沿って歩く (walk along the river), 線路に沿って家が並んでいる. The noun has length: a road, a river, a wall, a coast, a railway line.

Figuratively, it means acting in line with a plan, a policy, a manual or someone's wishes, keeping to it step by step: マニュアルに沿って作業する, お客様の希望に沿ってデザインを変える. Directly before a noun it becomes に沿った: 方針に沿った計画.

The edge: に基づいて says what something is built on (data, facts, a law) as its foundation; に沿って says you track a line or direction. に従って means obeying an order or rule, or "as X changes"; に沿って is gentler, following rather than obeying, and only に沿って works for a physical river or road. For a short walk down a street, plain を is normal (道を歩く); に沿って stresses keeping beside the line all the way.
patterns: [river / road / line] に沿って [歩く / 走る / 並ぶ]
[plan / manual / wishes] に沿って [進める / 行う / 変える]

examples.jp: 川[かわ]{にそって}散歩[さんぽ]しました。
examples.en: I took a walk along the river.

examples.jp: この道[みち]{にそって}桜[さくら]の木[き]が並[なら]んでいます。
海岸[かいがん]{にそって}、きれいな道[みち]が続[つづ]いている。
examples.en: A beautiful road runs along the coast.

examples.jp: マニュアル{にそって}作業[さぎょう]を進[すす]めてください。
examples.en: Please carry out the work following the manual.

examples.jp: お客様[きゃくさま]の希望[きぼう]{にそって}、デザインを変更[へんこう]しました。
examples.en: We changed the design in line with the customer's wishes.

examples.jp: 会社[かいしゃ]の方針[ほうしん]{にそった}計画[けいかく]を立[た]ててください。
examples.en: Please draw up a plan in line with company policy.

contrast.note: に基づいて names the foundation something rests on: データに基づいて判断する (judge on the basis of the data). に沿って follows a line or direction: 計画に沿って進める (proceed according to the plan). A conclusion drawn from data or evidence takes に基づいて.
に従って means obeying a rule or instruction (係員の指示に従ってください) or "as X changes" (年を取るに従って). It is firmer than に沿って, and it cannot describe running beside a river or road.
にわたって measures how far something extends (全国にわたって); に沿って says which line it runs beside.

mistakes.bad: 川[かわ]{にしたがって}歩[ある]きました。
mistakes.good: 川[かわ]{にそって}歩[ある]きました。
mistakes.note: に従って is for obeying or for change; a physical line you walk beside is に沿って.

mistakes.bad: これは会社[かいしゃ]の方針[ほうしん]{にそって}計画[けいかく]です。
mistakes.good: これは会社[かいしゃ]の方針[ほうしん]{にそった}計画[けいかく]です。
mistakes.note: Directly before a noun, に沿って becomes に沿った.

skills.tip: Picture a line you walk beside without stepping off it. River, road, plan, manual, wishes → に沿って.
